description_en: APARTMENT 2+1+2 FOR SALE APARTMENT 2+1+2 FOR SALE. The apartment is located in one of the newest buildings on st. Dritan Hoxha. Information about the property: Net area: 93.33 m² Gross area: 103.95 m² No. of rooms: 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, spacious corridor. Orientation south west. The technology used in this construction offers: Complete thermal insulation with ventilated facades. Complete acoustic insulation. Minimal cost of use and maintenance with energy efficiency. Other features: - Regular and functional layout. - Strategic location (access with the Tirana Durres highway, the Aviation Field and the Dritan Hoxha road).
